title: Virtual Compute: snapshot debit — prior adjustments
content:
## Applicable basis

Virtual Compute snapshot debit — Add signed prior posted correction credits and debit adjustments linked to that exact original source; payments, service credits, other sources and nonposted adjustments are excluded.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for snapshot debit — prior adjustments?**

Add signed prior posted correction credits and debit adjustments linked to that exact original source; payments, service credits, other sources and nonposted adjustments are excluded.
